_note: Per-weapon posture overrides, written by ↑↓ in game. A weapon named here wins over config.POSTURE_FACTOR for that posture. Keys starting with _ are not weapons and are never looked up.

_retired._why: Tuned by hand before 2026-08-09, when the posture factor multiplied the pre-plan-A curve. Those curves were deleted with the bullet-bucket coordinate, so these are corrections to a baseline this repository can no longer produce -- not weaker numbers, numbers about something else. Kept rather than deleted because they are the operator's own work and cost real magazines to arrive at; out of the lookup because applying them would silently override the one measured pair on 7 of 11 fired weapons. ⚠ p90 crouching 1.00 reads more like 'never adjusted' than 'measured as 1'.
